query: I want an agent available only when I work in a specific project. Where does the file go, and what makes it project-only?
expected_behavior: Explains it is discovered by walking up from the cwd, so it is not visible in other projects
Contrasts project scope with ~/.claude/agents/ (user-global, visible everywhere) and the plugin's agents/ dir
notes: Guards against putting a project-only agent in ~/.claude/agents/ (user-global), which makes it fire in every session. The 'location lock' is what makes an agent project-scoped, not the description.
